integrity: The proof is an exact integer transfer-matrix argument with independently reproduced small graph enumerations; no computational timeout or probabilistic inference is used.
limitations: Restricted to labelled ordinary edge-open packing on two-row cycle prisms; does not count suboptimal packings or symmetry orbits. Novelty comparison is not independent historical-priority certification.
title: Exact edge-open packing rigidity and multiplicity in cycle prisms
